A failed or pending deposit/withdrawal request is returned to your bank account within 3 business days.

To make it clear how this works, let's look at an actual example: a withdrawal request made on the evening of Jan 16, 2026 (Friday), after close of business at the bank. Jan 17 and 18 are weekend days, and Jan 19 is a USA Federal holiday.

The actual 3 business days are Jan 20 to 22, and you will see the funds in your bank account on Jan 23 (7 days after the failed deposit date).

Note that this applies to withdrawal requests and to failed deposits. Pending deposits also take 3 business days.

USD deposit is only available for the following countries at this time: Andorra, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Gibraltar, Greece, Guernsey, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Isle of Man, Italy, Jersey, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Principality of Monaco, Romania, San Marino, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain and the Canary Islands, Sweden, Switzerland, and the United States.

items.question: Unable to deposit using debit card

answer.text:
• Use a debit or credit card only (no prepaid or gift cards)
• Ensure your billing address matches your bank records exactly
• Confirm your CVV and card details
• Apple Cash is not supported
• Some banks don't support crypto transactions. Try a different debit card.
• If declined as temporary or due to risk, waiting and retrying may work.

Export your fomo key by going to your account page, tap on Settings, tap on Account, scroll to the bottom and click Export. Choose "Export EVM wallet" and use that private key in an Ethereum-compatible wallet like Rabby.

items.question: Withdrew to another app but not found

answer.text:
fomo sends USDC on Solana, Base, BNB Chain, or Monad. Make sure your wallet or service provider that receives these funds: 1) supports USDC, and 2) supports these blockchains.

At the time of reading, PayPal, Venmo, WealthSimple, Chime, and Robinhood DO NOT support USDC on these blockchains. You will not be credited on your destination platform if you withdraw to these.
